From 5875781c52e030c221fcf9a04f2bde3c8075fe4f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Josh Elser <elserj@apache.org>
Date: Sun, 22 Jun 2014 17:16:26 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] ACCUMULO-2935 Add a timeout to a test that otherwise hung
 indefinitely


diff --git a/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java b/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java
index 6d059212a6..4ea2663740 100644
--- a/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java
+++ b/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@ import org.junit.Test;
 
 public class MetaSplitIT extends SimpleMacIT {
 
-  @Test(expected = AccumuloException.class)
+  @Test(expected = AccumuloException.class, timeout = 30000)
   public void testRootTableSplit() throws Exception {
     TableOperations opts = getConnector().tableOperations();
     SortedSet<Text> splits = new TreeSet<Text>();
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `MetaSplitIT.java`**
   - The `@Test` annotation for the method `testRootTableSplit` was modified to include a `timeout` parameter. The timeout value was set to `30000` milliseconds (30 seconds). This change ensures that if the test does not complete within the specified time, it will fail instead of hanging indefinitely.

### Relationships
- The modification in `MetaSplitIT.java` directly addresses the issue of the test hanging indefinitely by implementing a timeout. This change enhances the reliability of the test by preventing it from blocking the test suite execution, thereby improving overall test management and feedback during the testing process.

The test `testRootTableSplit` in `MetaSplitIT.java` was hanging indefinitely due to a lack of a timeout, which prevented it from failing gracefully when it encountered issues during execution.      splits.add(new Text("5"));
     opts.addSplits(RootTable.NAME, splits);
   }
